name: Disjoining Strike (Su)
body:
Prerequisite(s): Magus 18, Dispelling Strike

Benefit(s): The magus can spend 5 points from his arcane pool as a swift action to imbue his weapon with devastating power. Once imbued, the magus may use his weapon to strike an enemy or object, which is immediately subjected to the single target version of mage’s disjunction on a successful hit. If targeting an opponent, the effect is applied to the subject’s armor, clothing, or other primary worn magic items. The target must succeed on a Will save (DC 10 + 1/2 the magus’ level + the magus’ Int modifier) to resist the effect.
